primary.description: Connected components across every primary and auxiliary trajectory using shared source-base ancestry or strong bidirectional captured-pose overlap.

conservativeSensitivity.description: Primary edges plus near-duplicate starts under the previously frozen tolerance. This is sensitivity analysis, not a threshold selected from model performance.

requirements: every outer evaluation fold has positive and negative primary groups
every outer training set has positive and negative primary groups
at least two positive primary training components remain after removing independent inner validation
no auxiliary component connected to evaluation is used for training

causalHistory.paddingImage: repeat earliest real image for tensor shape, then multiply its encoder output by zero availability before fusion
causalHistory.paddingMetadata: all-zero issued-action, executed-action, accepted, completed and reset metadata
causalHistory.realSlotMetadata: issued-action one-hot, executed-action one-hot, accepted, completed, episode-reset and availability
causalHistory.executionRule: executed action equals normalized issued action only when accepted and completed; otherwise RESET

correctiveRerun.earlyStopping: patience 16 after epoch 24 on group-balanced inner-validation loss; restore best epoch
correctiveRerun.loss: same P2 group-balanced BCE STOP plus 0.25 standardized-quality MSE
correctiveRerun.candidateSelection: same P2 rule: causal only if median spatial-group macro AP exceeds single-frame by at least 0.02; every-seed AP >=0.50, calibrated recall >=0.70, zero observed FP, and recognition of at least P-1 positive groups
correctiveRerun.calibration: pooled out-of-fold primary-policy predictions only; threshold is lowest score strictly above every development negative
